description: Shallots are a type of small onion with a subtle, distinguished flavor. The bulb is covered in papery red skin tinted rust, gold, or purple and has a tapered oblong shape with multiple cloves. They can be used fresh or dried in a variety of dishes.
sowing_method: Direct seed, thin to 5cm when seedlings are 3cm tall

growing_information.text:
Shallot is much like garlic, only it is milder,
and is grown in the same way. There is one
interesting difference, however, between the
two. The “cloves” of the garlic are all encased
in one outer skin, those of the shallot
grow separately.
